chunks: Disunnahkan memakai cincin dengan batu akik rubi.

key_terms.الْيَاقُوتِ: Korundum merah (batu permata berharga berwarna merah)
key_terms.يُسْتَحَبُّ: Amal yang dianjurkan atau disukai dalam fikih Islam

ai.seo_question: Apa batu permata yang direkomendasikan untuk cincin dalam hadis Syiah?
ai.summary: Hadith from al-Kafi highlights the preference for wearing a ruby ring, a practice deeply rooted in the customs of the Ahl al-Bayt and early Islamic society. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on dignified personal adornment as an expression of inner purity and social etiquette, distinguishing it from mere vanity. The recommendation underscores the balance between modesty and the appreciation of beauty within the framework of fiqh al-a'immah.
